notes: Inbound PLG lead from dev community post - landed on pricing page, created org (no AE).
Founders = 2 devs + 1 product. Building an AI 'pair programmer' in-browser extension for small teams.
Primary ask: hosted API that is cheap, fast, and easy to integrate (python + js).
Workload profile: lots of short-turn chat (200-400 tokens), occasional longer code context (2-4k tokens) + embeddings for repo search.
Latency target: interactive feel - want ~200ms median for generation on short prompts; willing to accept up to 500ms tail for larger contexts.
Cost: very sensitive — early product, runway limited. If cost grows >$2k/mo will look at cheaper quantized variants or caching strategies.

Model preference: prefer open/Redwood-curated smaller models for cost (mentions Llama-compat models) but need descent code generation quality. Open to multi-model routing (fast small model for simple intents, larger model for code synth).
Integration notes: using streaming + function-calling style webhooks to pipe generated code to editor; important that streaming is smooth (no chunking delays).
Security: not enterprise yet but wants SOC2 & audit logs for future buyers; asked about retention controls and API key rotation.
Quote from founder: 'We need something that just works out of the box — we don't want to manage infra. If Redwood's hosted latency/cost is right we'll stick.'
Wants per-route cost/latency telemetry in Console so can tune prompts and switch models programmatically.
Mentioned potential ramp if 1) cost stays < $1k/mo and 2) streaming latency < 250ms for majority of requests — could be paying customer in 2-3 months.
Has small test corpus — willing to share sample prompts for eval (asked about secure upload flow).
Notes: indie devs, high velocity, typical PLG path -> likely to convert by usage not AE negotiation.
